findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Algebra/Module/Rat.lean:19-21` explicitly introduces `moduleNNRat` so `Ring.choose` works on possibly noncommutative ℚ-algebras, while `Polynomial.Sequence.linearIndependent_of_isRightRegular_leadingCoeff` and the Pochhammer lemmas already assume only `Ring`.
findings.fix: Replace `[CommRing K]` with `[Ring K]` throughout this section and retain commutativity only on any individual declaration that demonstrably requires it.
findings.issue: All declarations in this file assume `[CommRing K]`, although their arguments use only `[Ring K] [Algebra ℚ K]`; this prevents use with noncommutative ℚ-algebras such as universal enveloping algebras.

summary: The binomial-polynomial API is unnecessarily restricted to commutative coefficient rings, excluding the noncommutative rational algebras motivating this infrastructure.
